title: Champions League: Titles and Recent Finals
intro: Europe's premier club competition, from the 1956 European Cup to the present. Who has won it most, how the last ten finals went, and when the current season is played.
dataNote: Verified through the 2026 final, won by Paris Saint-Germain against Arsenal in Budapest. The country table now accounts for all 71 editions played — the single titles won by Celtic, Steaua București and Red Star Belgrade were missing from it before, which made the list look complete when it was not. The full year-by-year list back to 1956 is still being compiled.

next.summary: The league phase opened on 8 September 2026 and runs to the end of January. A World Cup summer pushed the whole calendar later than usual, which is why matchday two does not come until mid-October.
next.caution: Matchday eight is played as a single round with every fixture kicking off simultaneously, so that no team learns its required result in advance. Dates for the knockout rounds are UEFA's published slots; individual kick-off times are set closer to each round.
next.checked: Checked three times against UEFA's published calendar, including its own calendar-by-matchday document, on 11 September 2026.
